runs.goal_hypothesis: Establish the corrected defensive-opening curriculum without potential shaping.

results_insights.insight: The fixed unshaped control ended at only 14.83% average win rate.
At least one evaluated matchup had zero wins.
Combined-O was a zero-win matchup with 4.92-move average games.

reasoning: The corrected curriculum alone did not yield robust terminal performance.
Rapid zero-win combined-O games were a principal weakness.
The fix is shared by both group runs but is not independently compared to an identical pre-fix control here.

runs.goal_hypothesis: Test slight shaping in the corrected defensive curriculum, while disclosing the simultaneous higher starting learning rate.

results_insights.insight: The shaped/higher-LR variant improved average win rate by 5.33 percentage points.
The floor improved from zero to 1% but remained weak.
Defensive-X rose from 9% to 36%, over 26.07-move games.
The defensive matchup remained long while becoming more winnable.

reasoning: The shaped variant improved average and defensive-X results over the fixed control.
Both shaping and starting learning rate changed, so their contributions cannot be separated.
The remaining 1% floor indicates the improvement did not solve broad robustness.
